checks: Real calibration requests DOM full screen, native full screen, stable viewport, then starts; first target is acknowledged only after two painted animation frames with geometry
Each new target moves to server coordinates and receives one acknowledgement; repeated polling does not relabel or duplicate it, and controls avoid top targets
Preparation calibration does not intercept Alt+Tab, copy or Windows keys and creates no exam violation events
Only server-confirmed calibrated completion closes both fullscreen layers and advertises readiness
Esc immediately removes the surface, restores native window and leaves key handling free even if server cancellation fails
Network failure restores the ordinary window before server cancellation and offers retry with an honest failure message
Display geometry changes invalidate the in-progress calibration instead of labelling frames against displaced targets
Denied full screen never starts real calibration or reports success
A terminal phase without calibrated server flag is rejected, preserving no false real-mode success
A delayed cancellation carries its old calibration ID and cannot invalidate a newly started wizard
Cancelling before the start response never sends an unidentified cancellation; late response cleans only its own ID while the new wizard remains active
Deferred native fullscreen begin is followed by queued cancellation before a new begin; its late completion cannot close the newer calibration
Phone policy is first-frame, teacher editor cannot imply configurable waiting, and participant/report labels distinguish phone, gaze, head and unknown reasons
limitations: Executed DOM and JavaScript against controlled native/API doubles. Does not validate physical Windows rendering, camera accuracy or native fullscreen implementation.
